values.note: '13 sites for tent and small trailer use' (the DNR's standard state forest wording). The 40-ft maximum comes from an earlier note citing a DNR listing that two sites take a 40-ft vehicle/trailer; neither the current page nor its June 2025 version states it.

note: Rustic state forest campground on shallow, warm-water Muskrat Lake, 12 mi NW of Mio via M-33 North, West Miller Road, Richardson Road and Muskrat Lake Road. Two sites accommodate a 40-ft vehicle/trailer (per an earlier DNR listing). Carry-in access to the lake; ORVs may ride between the campground and the trails (Mio ATV trail). Managed by Rifle River Recreation Area. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: sites 12 -> 13 (page and table), $20 (confirmed) + Recreation Passport, not reservable (confirmed). The current page has no 'what to expect' block; its June 2025 archived version gave first-come, vault toilets, hand-pump water, no electric and a 15-day maximum, all matching the stored derived values, which were left as they are. Season (open all year) already manual and matches. Max rig 40 ft (derived from the note) left: no DNR page read states it. Table: type 'rustic' (not an ORV trail camp), ORV operation between campground and trails allowed, carry-in access (not a ramp). Note corrected ('Boat ramp' -> carry-in access) and trimmed of field restatements.
flags: Phone: the entry has none. The DNR campground page and the amenity table give 989-473-2258 (Rifle River Recreation Area, the managing park).
